Item 1. Business

We design and sell smartphones, computers and wearables worldwide. Our operations span design, manufacturing, distribution and after-sales support across a global network of suppliers, contract manufacturers and logistics partners that together let us bring new products to market on a predictable annual cadence. We continue to invest in engineering, retail experiences, and complementary offerings that deepen customer relationships over multi-year product cycles across every region we serve, while expanding our footprint in emerging markets through a mix of direct retail and third-party channel partnerships.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business is subject to supply chain concentration in a single region, which could materially affect our results of operations if a natural disaster, labor disruption, or geopolitical event were to interrupt production for an extended period. We are also exposed to currency fluctuations, evolving trade policy, component shortages, and competitive pricing pressure across the many markets in which we sell our products and services worldwide, and any of these factors, alone or in combination, could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition.

Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments

None.

Item 2. Properties

Our principal executive offices and a substantial majority of our research and development facilities are located on land we own, supplemented by a number of leased office, retail and distribution facilities across the regions in which we operate, none of which we consider individually material to our business as a whole.

Item 3. Legal Proceedings

We are subject to various legal proceedings and claims that have arisen in the ordinary course of business and have not yet been fully resolved, and while the outcome of these matters is inherently uncertain, we do not currently believe any of them, individually or in the aggregate, will have a material adverse effect on our financial condition.

Item 4. Mine Safety Disclosures

Not applicable.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis

Net sales increased in fiscal 2024 driven by services growth across every geographic segment, partially offset by softer demand for certain hardware categories in a handful of developed markets during the back half of the year. Operating margin improved year over year as cost discipline and a favorable mix of higher-margin services revenue more than offset incremental investment in research and development and go-to-market programs, and we expect these trends to continue into the following fiscal year barring a material change in macroeconomic conditions.
